name: Mary (mother of John Mark)
title: Hostess for the church in Jerusalem
summary: Mary was the mother of John Mark, and her house in Jerusalem was a gathering place for believers. It was there that Peter went after an angel had led him out of prison while the church was gathered in prayer.

keyEvents.title: The church gathers in her house
keyEvents.description: When Peter was freed by an angel, he went to Mary's house where many were gathered in prayer, and the servant girl Rhoda recognized his voice.
